title: A finite-mass current with positive lower density and Hⁿ-absolutely continuous mass is θHⁿ⌞M with a unit orientation
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, Γ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P), μ a finite Borel measure on ℝ^P with μ(W) = M_W(Γ) for every open W, ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x and all n-covectors α (|·| = covectorEuclideanNorm), Γ(ω) = ∫ξ(x)(ω(x))dμ(x) for all test n-forms ω, μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0 (Hⁿ = μHE[n]), and, for some η₀ > 0, liminf_{r↓0}μ(B_r(x))/(ω_nrⁿ) ≥ η₀ for μ-a.e. x (ω_n = unitBallVolume n). Then there are a Borel set M with Hⁿ(M) < ∞, a Borel θ : ℝ^P → ℝ with θ > 0 on M, and a strongly measurable ζ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) with |ζ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α, such that μ = (Hⁿ⌞M) with density ofReal∘θ, for each x ∈ M some β with |β| ≤ 1 has ζ(x)(β) = 1, Γ(ω) = ∫_Mθ(x)ζ(x)(ω(x))dHⁿ(x) for every test form ω, and liminf_{r↓0}μ(B_r(x))/(ω_nrⁿ) ≥ η₀ for every x ∈ M.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Γ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (η₀ : ℝ), 0 < η₀ → μ univ < ∞ → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → Γ.massOn W = μ W) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, Γ ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μ) → (∀ E : Set (Euclid P), μHE[n] E = 0 → μ E = 0) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ENNReal.ofReal η₀ ≤ liminf (fun r : ℝ => μ (ball x r) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0)) → ∃ (M : Set (Euclid P)) (θ : Euclid P → ℝ) (ζ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), MeasurableSet M ∧ μHE[n] M < ∞ ∧ Measurable θ ∧ StronglyMeasurable ζ ∧ μ = (μHE[n].restrict M).withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (θ x)) ∧ (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x) ∧ (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ζ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ (∀ x ∈ M, ∃ β : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm β ≤ 1 ∧ ζ x β = 1) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, Γ ω = ∫ x in M, θ x * ζ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) ∧ (∀ x ∈ M, ENNReal.ofReal η₀ ≤ liminf (fun r : ℝ => μ (ball x r) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0))
